text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My name? Well, it comes from the place
I was
born. They call me Kentucky...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Quick Draw Kentucky!

text_block_list.name: Gunman Actor
text_block_list.text:
You got a mean look to ya. But in these
parts,
they call me Lone Wolf Joe. And I
walk a... lone...

text_block_list.name: Gunman Actor
text_block_list.text:
Argh. Sorry. Can we cut? I just can't land
the
whole "lone wolf" thing. Director,
could you give
me an idea of what
you're looking for?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, right... What I'm lookin for is...

Uhhh... A-anyway, let's take five,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
How do I explain the essence of a lone
wolf?
Ngh... I can see it in my head,
but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've got a great idea!
Okay, y'all!
Grab your stuff and let's go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Huh? Go where?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki! Are you listening to me?! This
isn't the
time to frolic around a zoo!

text_block_list.name: Zoo Wolf
text_block_list.text: AWOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Look at the wolf howl! Isn't it much
cooler seein' it
for yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh... Um... You're right. And also,
there's a
kind of sadness to it... and
refinement...

text_block_list.name: Gunman Actor
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I get it! I think I've got a good
grasp on the
role now. Yeah, I know just
what to do!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
What?! What do you mean the backdrop
is
broken?! How are we supposed to
shoot the next
scene without a
backdrop?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Sounds like a good chance for a
construction
competition! Let's get to
hammerin'! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All finished! Whaddya think? Will this
backdown
do?

text_block_list.name: Art Staff
text_block_list.text: Haha! You mean backdrop, right? But, yeah, it's perfect! It looks like getting everyone's input really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
It sure did...
A-anyway... Let's get rolling!

text_block_list.name: Construction Staff
text_block_list.text:
You guys are filming a movie?! I hate to
break it
to you, but this site is scheduled
for construction.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You know what that means! We're going
on an
adventure! Time to go location
scoutin', y'all!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
An adventure... Oh! What about that
park we
passed by earlier?! There was
something I liked
about its atmosphere.
Let's look around there!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
All done for the day! Man... One thing
after
another. I was starting to think
we'd never finish.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
But it ended up being quite a productive
day!
And it's all thanks to you, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Me? Really?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happened, you kept
your chin up
and met every setback
head-on... You gave me
the drive to
keep going!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! ♪ It's like I always say!
Make
lemonade!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Make... lemonade?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You know, when life gives you—well
anyway, it
means you gotta seize the
day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's how I was brought up back on the
farm!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Farms're so peaceful 'n' quiet! But
depending on
the season and the
weather, they can be kinda
rough.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When it's freezin' cold or rainin' cats and
dogs,
you can get stuck inside for ages.
But does that
make it a bad day? Heck
no!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Take sheep, for instance! They always
look awful
cozy all bunched up together
in the cold!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And you can bet your behind my family
always
had a blast cuttin' a rug and
knittin' in front of the
fire on rainy days.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you keep focused on what's in front of
you and
what you can do, every single
day can be a lovely
one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Point is, don't dwell on the past or worry
about
the future. Think about the now!
Seize the day!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! So the reason we were able
to finish
today's shoot is because we
were focusing on the
now...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
That must've been what I saw in your
smile, on the
day I offered you the part.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to another
productive shoot
with you tomorrow!
Let's do our best and make
that
lemonade!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to shake up my routine with a
walk one
day, when...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Taiki. For the next scene, I'd like
you to try
and put some pathos into your
lines!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! I hear ya loud 'n' clear!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're the trainer from the party the
other
day! Yessir! Things are goin' just
swell here!

This workplace is bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're the trainer from the party the
other
day! Yes, ma'am! Things are goin'
just swell here!

私に何か手伝えることはある？

Turns out you've got a talent for acting, too!
Is there anything I can help with?
Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! The director's been giving me
loads of
pointers, so I reckon I'm getting
much better!
Check this out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There are two types of Umamusume in
this world,
my friend—those who dig for
carrots, and those
who eat 'em!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! You've got an eye for talent!
Wanna join
the crew? Makin' movies is
loads of fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm brought on board to do odd
jobs
behind the scenes.
choice_data_list_en: If you're okay with me, I'd love to!
I'd love to, if you'll have me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There are two types of Umamusume in
this world,
my friend—those who dig for
carrots, and those
who feed 'em!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Daggummit! I fumbled the line!
But it's
all good! Failure's just a steppin' stone
to
success! I'll get it next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Taiki Shuttle manages to
successfully
wrap up the day's shoot,
and gets plenty of praise
from the crew.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You sure can! I think the director was
lookin' for
an extra to play the cactus!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some negotiation between Taiki
Shuttle and
the director, I end up cast in
a role as a human.
choice_data_list_en: Does a cactus even need an actor?!
